description: A bounded metadata review with one historical retirement signal and single-individual ownership risk; nothing is applied or certified unused.

checks.message: Only the selected scope was inspected.
Similarity is not credential/binding equivalence or a winner selection.
This metadata read was authorized, not cleanup.
Historical recency is a review signal, not current dependency evidence.
A single individual owner is continuity risk, not proof of orphaning or failed credentials.

preview.message: Historical review only, not deletion eligibility.
Review a separately selected supported owner; this service-principal example is not an automatic choice. Admin grants do not support Group; Owner requests may remain pending.

notChecked: all current item/external dependencies or proof of unused connections
stored credential health, source authorization and other identities
human approval, credential handoff or mutation permissions
data.limitations: GET-only historical metadata and review previews; no mutation, credential test or automatic ordinary-connection fallback.

notes: The command itself is read-only; destructive:true describes proposed retirement PREVIEWS, each still readyToApply:false with review/approval blockers. Missing/partial role evidence suppresses mutation previews. PendingOwner produces handoff review, never effective ownership or automatic transfer. Similar targets do not produce a keepId/winner.
